```{r}
#| label: setup
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)

bigfoot <- read_csv("data/bigfoot.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

The data contains `r format(nrow(bigfoot), big.mark = ",")` reports of Bigfoot sightings submitted to the [Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO)](https://www.bfro.net/).
Reports are classified as:

- **Class A**: clear sightings, where the witness saw the animal in good conditions;
- **Class B**: incidents where the witness heard or saw something at a distance or in poor conditions;
- **Class C**: second-hand reports.

## Sightings over time

```{r}
#| label: fig-per-year
#| fig-cap: "Number of reported sightings per year since 1950."
bigfoot |>
  filter(!is.na(date)) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  filter(year >= 1950) |>
  count(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4B7F52") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of sightings") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Where are the sightings?

```{r}
#| label: tbl-states
#| tbl-cap: "The ten states with the most reported sightings."
bigfoot |>
  count(state, sort = TRUE, name = "sightings") |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("State", "Sightings"))
```

## Seasons and report quality

```{r}
#| label: fig-season
#| fig-cap: "Reported sightings by season and BFRO classification."
bigfoot |>
  filter(season != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter"))) |>
  count(season, classification) |>
  ggplot(aes(season, n, fill = classification)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Class A" = "#2E4A62", "Class B" = "#8FB996", "Class C" = "#D9A441")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of sightings", fill = "Classification") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Map of sightings

Sightings with coordinates, grouped into clusters. Zoom in to see individual reports and click a marker to read its title.

```{r}
#| label: fig-map
#| fig-cap: "Location of reported Bigfoot sightings."
sightings <- bigfoot |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))

palette <- colorFactor(
  c("#2E4A62", "#8FB996", "#D9A441"),
  domain = c("Class A", "Class B", "Class C")
)

leaflet(sightings) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = ~palette(classification),
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", title, "</b><br>", date, " (", classification, ")"),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions()
  ) |>
  addLegend(pal = palette, values = ~classification, title = "Classification")
```
